title: Coral and the Bell
author: V. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Ada Hartwell, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
